slides.title: Nvidia Jet-Nemotron and Nemotron Nano Nvidia Jet-Nemotron and
slides.text: Nvidia Jet-Nemotron and Nemotron Nano Nvidia Jet-Nemotron and Nemotron Nano Jet-Nemotron is a newer hybrid-architecture LLM series, specifically engineered for extreme inference speed and resource efficiency by employing a combination of full-attention and novel JetBlock linear attention modules; available in very small sizes (2B and 4B params) and are 53x faster than previous models; Core innovations include the PostNAS pipeline (post-training architecture search) and JetBlock technology https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.15884 Nemotron Nano (notably, the Nano 2 9B model) is part of the original Nemotron family and leverages a hybrid Transformer-Mamba backbone; most full-attention layers are replaced by efficient Mamba-2 state space modules for speed and edge hardware suitability; Nemotron Nano models are generally larger than Jet-Nemotron (e.g., Nano 2 is 9B), achieving strong throughput (up to 6x faster than alternatives) but not matching the Jet-Nemotron’s headline throughput in small model regimes Both series focus on hy Nemotron Nano leverages Mamba-2 blocks , while Jet-Nemotron uses JetBlock and a hardware-aware architecture search for even greater efficiency in smaller models Jet-Nemotron retrofits existing pre-trained Transformer models by freezing MLP weights and systematically replacing most full-attention layers with JetBlock linear attention blocks Strategic retention of some full-attention layers ensures high accuracy for complex reasoning and retrieval tasks The majority of computation is handled by efficient linear or dynamic JetBlock designs - this reduces memory (especially KV cache size) and compute requirements, allowing much faster inference

slides.text: Nvidia Jet-Nemotron and Nemotron Nano Nvidia Jet-Nemotron and Nemotron Nano Jet-Nemotron is a newer hybrid-architecture LLM series, specifically engineered for extreme inference speed (53x) and resource efficiency. Available in 2B & 4B params sizes, but same technology can be used in bigger models The model is trained normally. Then the MLP weights are frozen, but attention is optimized using PostNAS pipeline (post-training architecture search) where most of full-attention blocked are substituted with JetBlock linear attention blocks - https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.15884 Nemotron Nano (notably, the Nano 2 9B model) is part of the original Nemotron family and leverages a hybrid Transformer-Mamba backbone; most full-attention layers are replaced by efficient Mamba-2 state space modules for speed and edge hardware suitability; Nemotron Nano models are generally larger than Jet-Nemotron (e.g., Nano 2 is 9B), achieving strong throughput (up to 6x faster than alternatives) but not matching the Jet-Nemotron’s headline throughput in small model regimes Both series focus on hy Nemotron Nano leverages Mamba-2 blocks , while Jet-Nemotron uses JetBlock and a hardware-aware architecture search for even greater efficiency in smaller models

slides.title: Google MAD (Max Adaptive Degree) Google MAD (Max
slides.text: Google MAD (Max Adaptive Degree) Google MAD (Max Adaptive Degree) Privacy-preserving algorithm developed by Google and MIT for detecting subtle online trends without exposing individual user data https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rREARu5U184 Challenge - discovering important rare phrases, niche topics, or early trends in massive datasets without accidentally revealing unique user queries or activities Every data item starts with equal weight. When an item's score is far above the privacy threshold, MAD trims excess weight off that item and rerouts to underrepresented, smaller items —amplifying quieter signals; The system then fine-tunes the balance, adds Gaussian noise for privacy, and produces a result set of interesting items Think of the old system as a traffic jam: popular "lanes" get clogged while less-traveled "lanes" barely move. MAD dynamically shifts "traffic" (data weight) to underutilized lanes so new, rare signals get visibility without compromising anyone's privacy. MAD2R - advanced version , runs the process in two rounds. First yields a rough sketch of trends using noisy data, then refines the output by focusing the algorithm on promising trends, further improving accuracy The algorithm was tested on nine massive datasets (including Reddit, IMDb, Twitter, Wikipedia, Amazon, and Common Crawl). MAD2R outperformed previous privacy-preserving methods on most benchmarks, surfacing significantly more unique items from large pools of data

slides.title: AI for Podcast Process/Create Tomasz Tunguz - AI-Powered
slides.text: AI for Podcast Process/Create Tomasz Tunguz - AI-Powered Podcast Processing System "Parakeet podcast processor" to stay on top of 36 podcasts/week Daily Processing Pipeline: Downloads podcast files automatically each day Transcribes audio using Nvidia's Parakeet (previously OpenAI's Whisper) Cleans transcripts using Gemma 3 to remove filler words while preserving technical content Stores processed files in a local DuckDB database Generate daily summaries containing Host and guest info and  summaries, Key quotes, Actionable investment theses for venture capital opportunities, Company mentions that might warrant further research, Twitter post suggestions, Blog post prompts in Tom's writing style Blog Post Generation Workflow: Use AI to generate blog post drafts Use an "AP English teacher" grading system Three rounds of self-critique until reaching an A- grade Focus on improving hooks, transitions, and conclusions Maintain his preferred style: 500 words or less, no section headers, flowing paragraphs with max two sentences each Tom operates entirely in the terminal for speed and low latency, using tools like Claude Code for rapid modifications. Initially tried to keep everything local using Ollama and Stanford NLP libraries, but shifted to more powerful cloud models for better named entity extraction. Despite fine-tuning models and providing 2,000 blog posts as context, Tom acknowledges that AI still struggles to perfectly capture his writing voice and linking patterns. Individuals can now build custom tools that fit their exact workflows - something that wasn't economically feasible before generative AI AI can be very effective as a writing assistant for feedback and iteration rather than wholesale content generation. The system exemplifies how AI can augment human capabilities while maintaining editorial control and personal voice in the final output. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8P7v1lgl-1s Claire Vo             Tomasz Tunguz

slides.title: AI Updates 2 AI Hits Entry-Level Jobs Hardest
slides.text: AI Updates 2 AI Hits Entry-Level Jobs Hardest Stanford study - 13% drop in employment for early-career workers in AI-exposed fields since 2022, especially in software engineering and customer service Younger workers are more vulnerable as their skills often overlap with what AI like ChatGPT can do. Older employees fare better due to experience-based knowledge.ple in AI https://time.com/collections/time100-ai-2025/ How Cloudflare runs more AI models on fewer GPUs Omni is Cloudflare’s internal platform for efficiently running and managing multiple (small) AI models on a single machine and GPU using lightweight isolation techniques. Omni is a control plane and runtime system that allows Cloudflare to spawn, orchestrate, and manage multiple AI models on their edge network nodes. Its purpose is to fully maximize GPU usage by allowing multiple small or low-volume models to share GPU resources, minimizing idle capacity and improving overall system efficiency. Note: Cloudflare is public technology company with over 4K employees, ~ $1.7B annual revenue, ~$75B Market Cap Cloudflare is a big CDN (Content Delivery Network) with many useful services https://blog.cloudflare.com/how-cloudflare-runs-more-ai-models-on-fewer-gpus/

slides.title: AI Updates 3 Microsoft VibeVoice - open-source text-to-speech
slides.text: AI Updates 3 Microsoft VibeVoice - open-source text-to-speech (TTS) framework Convert text into multi-speaker audio (up to 4 voices, up to 90 min) Ideal for podcasts, audiobooks, interviews, or multi-character narration without the need for manual audio editing or splicing Two-part architecture: a LLM to interpret the text flow and emotions, and specialized “diffusion head” generates high-fidelity, natural-sounding speech Can handle emotional nuance and subtle vocal dynamics, including limited singing capabilities. Cross-lingual ability: Primarily trained in English and Chinese no simultaneous speaking or background effects Contains audio watermarks and disclaimers to prevent misuse and ensure ethical standards. VibeVoice-1.5B: Lightweight, efficient model for faster inference and smaller setups VibeVoice-Large (~9–10B) - better quality Ouperformed Gemini-2.5 TTS (Google) and Eleven-V3 (ElevenLabs) https://github.com/microsoft/VibeVoice.git https://huggingface.co/microsoft/VibeVoice-1.5B Apple FastVLM and MobileCLIP2 VLMs Small open-source Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on Hugging Face https://www.reddit.com/r/LocalLLaMA/comments/1n3b13b/apple_releases_fastvlm_and_mobileclip2_on_hugging/ These models can r un directly in the browser , leveraging WebGPU for real-time applications such as live video captioning

slides.title: AI Updates 4 Weaviate 8-bit Rotational Quantization Compress
slides.text: AI Updates 4 Weaviate 8-bit Rotational Quantization Compress Vectors by 4x, need 4x less memory, similarity search runs much faster Loses 1-2% of recall "Rotational" means that when setting up the system, a random rotation matrix is created. This matrix will "spin" every vector in the same way, so when comparing vectors, the math always makes sense. Random rotation randomizes the weights between vectors' elements, thus making their values more "even", thus improving the quality of compression. Authors used 3 rounds of rotations https://weaviate.io/blog/8-bit-rotational-quantization AI helps paralyzed patients control robots UCLA Wearable EEG AI Decoder interprets EEG signals and enables paralyzed users to control robotic arms using their thoughts without invasive surgery Paired EEG decoder with a camera-based AI Tested on four users, including one paralyzed participant who completed robotic tasks in 6.5 minutes versus being unable to without it Participants moved cursors to targets and directed robotic arms to relocate blocks, completing both tasks nearly 4x faster with AI assistance. The system used standard EEG caps, eliminating surgical risks while still achieving performance levels similar to the invasive alternatives https://www.eurekalert.org/news-releases/1096148

slides.title: Automating Browser with Selenium & Playwright Automating Browser
slides.text: Automating Browser with Selenium & Playwright Automating Browser with Selenium & Playwright https://medium.com/codrift/i-tried-automating-my-entire-browser-with-python-now-i-barely-click-anything-3789288002ce pip install selenium from selenium import webdriver from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By driver = webdriver.Chrome() driver.get("https://example.com/login") driver.find_element(By.ID, "username").send_keys("myusername") driver.find_element(By.ID, "password").send_keys("mypassword") driver.find_element(By.ID, "submit").click() pip install playwright playwright install from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright with sync_playwright() as p: browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True) page = browser.new_page() page.goto("https://example.com") page.fill("#username", "myusername") page.fill("#password", "mypassword") page.click("#submit") print(page.title()) browser.close() form_data = { "name": "John", "project": "myproj", "hours": "8",} for field, value in form_data.items(): page.fill(f"input[name='{field}']", value) page.click("button[type='submit']") pip install 2captcha-python from twocaptcha import TwoCaptcha solver = TwoCaptcha('YOUR_API_KEY') result = solver.normal('captcha.jpg') print(result['code'])  # Send this value to the input field page.click("a.download-report") page.wait_for_timeout(3000) browser_context = browser.new_context(accept_downloads=True) pip install schedule import schedule, time schedule.every().day.at("16:00").do(download_report) while True: schedule.run_pending() time.sleep(1) # WhatsApp pip install pywhatkit import pywhatkit as kit kit.sendwhatmsg("+1234567890", "This message was sent with Python!", 17, 30)

slides.title: Fast Growth: Base44, Bolt.new, Lovable Base44 ~ 7
slides.text: Fast Growth: Base44, Bolt.new, Lovable Base44 ~ 7 months to $40M ARR (?); was acquired by Wix in June 2025 when it had 250K-400K users, and almost doubled after that Base44 has use personal connections to test and improve MVP,  users were sharing their "Wow!" reactions. The platform prioritized minimizing friction, encouraging exploration and immediate results, which triggered user-driven viral expansion. Base44 focused on authentic storytelling and regular updates about product advances in public forums— especially LinkedIn —to cultivate a broad audience of indie hackers and non-technical creators. The founder even built internal tools powered by Base44 to automate engaging social content, which itself served as live demos for prospects. The company rewarded customers with platform credits for posting about their creations , transforming each user into a marketing engine and accelerating organic, community-driven growth Tech stack:  Frontend - React (JavaScript/TypeScript), CSS, ...; Can be exported only on paid plans. Backend - proprietary Base44 (can not be exported) Lovable ~7 months to $40M ARR, $120M ARR in Aug 2025. Originally (2023) as an open-source coding tool ("GPT-Engineer") that quickly garnered tens of thousands of GitHub stars and a strong early community (hundreds of thousands of of early “tinkerers”.. October 2024 received $7.5M Pre-Seed Funding - pay for development and GPU By February achieved $10M ARR, 30K+ paying customers, 85% 30-day user retention February 2025 - $15M Series A - started aggressive PPC (Pay-Per-Click) advertising, 12+ growth channels simultaneously, including Linkedin, X (Twitter), Discord, Youtube, Google, partnerships, Github, Product Hunt, podcasts, events, ads, and Reddit - reportedly adding 1,500 customers per day; frequent campaigns offering free access; blogging, partnerships; 54K stars on GitHub; Using Lovable itself to build marketing campaign pages; actively collecting user feedback, rapidly iterating on product features, and maintaining open communication across channels; The emphasis on fast troubleshooting, instant undo actions, and responsive AI ensures users get the help and outcomes they want without delay Tech stack:  React (JavaScript/TypeScript); Vite and Tailwind CSS for styling, node.js based backend code, build tooling; Integrations for backend services (Supabase, Cloudflare hosting, third-party APIs). User can export code to run on his own infrastructure Bolt.new ~5 months to $40M ARR (in July 2025), 5Mln+ users viral, community-centered, and influencer-led marketing, a “build-in-public” ethos, and lightning-fast product execution referral programs where users earn free credits for bringing new users “World’s Largest Hackathon” attracted 100K+ signups Bolt.new strategically sponsored prominent indie developer influencers such as Pieter Levels and engaged with the tech Twitter/X and IndieHackers communities Frequent publications about constant product improvements Bolt.new made it easy for users to launch and share what they built, with integrations into platforms like Netlify, Supabase, and GitHub - a tactic that “piggybacks” on existing user bases Tech stack:  JavaScript-based for both front-end and back-end development, emphasizing Node.js StackBlitz’s WebContainers (Rust+WASM) run GUI in browser Code export is supported
